```{r}
t8 <- read_dta("/Users/liualis/.../T8_tear_osmo.dta")

t102 <- t102 %>%
  left_join(t8, by = c("studyid", "visitdate"), keep = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    merge_T8 = case_when(
      !is.na(osmo1) & !is.na(lang_help) ~ 3L,
      is.na(osmo1) & !is.na(lang_help) ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ 2L
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-osmo1, -osmo2, -nomissing)

```
